:::{#exm-random-variable}
#### Number of heads in two coin flips

Flip a fair coin twice.
The sample space is $\samplespace = \set{HH, HT, TH, TT}$,
each outcome with probability $1/4$.
Let $X$ be the number of heads:

$$
\begin{aligned}
X(HH) &= 2, \\
X(HT) &= 1, \\
X(TH) &= 1, \\
X(TT) &= 0
\end{aligned}
$$

Then $\{X = 1\} = \set{HT, TH}$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Pr(X = 1) &= 1/4 + 1/4 \\
&= 1/2.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
